result_summary.title: Config Manager Unresponsive and Causing App Crashes in APAC Sandbox
result_summary.description: We are experiencing severe issues with the Config Manager in our APAC sandbox environment. The service is unresponsive, which appears to be causing our applications to crash. We have also reported a full outage of the configuration delivery mechanism. This affects about 48 users in the sandbox. We believe the Config Manager is the root cause as the application crashes correlate directly with config fetch attempts.
